## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link related source evidence
or an existing issue.

## Validation

List checks run and their results. State which checks were not run.
For engine changes, describe the failure path and recovery behavior.

## Hardware evidence

State whether this change has physical hardware evidence. Distinguish local
observations, third-party reports, and synthetic checks. Do not include raw GPU
UUIDs, private logs, credentials, or unlicensed firmware binaries.
